stories.title: The Owl Who Loved Mornings
stories.tease: Every owl loves midnight. Sol kept yawning through it. A gentle bedtime story about a little owl whose eyes grew heavy when the moon grew tall — and the dawn the whole forest learned why someone different is someone needed. For every early bird in a family of night owls.

stories.title: Lumen and the Kind Jar
stories.tease: On the night of falling stars, gentle hands caught the brightest firefly in the meadow. A tender bedtime story about a kind jar, a fading glow, and the moment a child understood what love had to do. For every little one learning that loving something means letting it shine where it belongs.

stories.title: The Whale Who Sang Too Deep
stories.tease: In the bright singing pod, one voice was never heard. A gentle ocean bedtime story about Wren, whose song rolled too deep for anyone to notice — until the day only a deep song could reach the bottom of the dark canyon. For every quiet little one whose voice gets talked over.

stories.title: Poppy and the New Egg
stories.tease: Poppy had mama all to herself. Then came the egg. A gentle bedtime story about jealousy, one long terrible breath of hesitation, and the stormy night a little duckling learned to love what she thought had replaced her. For every little one about to become a big brother or sister.

stories.title: The Elephant Who Was Afraid of Small Things
stories.tease: The biggest baby at the river feared the smallest things. A gentle bedtime story about Juno, who could carry logs but jumped at beetles — and the dry season when watching the ground where small things live saved the whole herd. For every big kid with big feelings.

stories.title: The Sock Who Lost His Twin
stories.tease: Two socks went into the washer. Only one came out. A gentle bedtime story about Blue, who searched the whole wilderness of the house for his missing twin — and what he found instead in the lost and found box. For every little one missing a friend who moved away.

stories.title: The Root Who Worked in the Dark
stories.tease: Everyone watched the little sprout. No one watched below. A gentle bedtime story about Root, who grew down in the dark while her twin drank the morning — and the burning July day when the invisible work saved everything. For every little one whose hard work goes unseen.

stories.title: The Thunder Who Was Shy
stories.tease: When Boom whispered hello, every window slammed shut. A gentle bedtime story about a little thundercloud who held his big voice in — until the night the river rose and the sleeping valley needed the loudest lullaby in the world. For every little one who has ever been told they are too much.

stories.title: The Snail Who Lit the Lighthouse
stories.tease: The night the great light died, the slowest snail on the cliff began to climb. A gentle stormy-night bedtime story about Pearl, whose glistening trail — the thing she always hid — becomes the light that brings three boats home. For every little one who feels too small and too slow.

stories.title: The Moth Who Was Afraid of the Dark
stories.tease: Every moth loves the dark — except Plume, who was born at noon and never let go of the light. A gentle bedtime story about the night she got lost between the lamps, and what her wings did when the moon finally found them. For every little one who sleeps with the light on.

stories.title: The Backpack Who Was Scared of School
stories.tease: The night before the first day of school, Mila finds her brand new backpack hiding under the bed — trembling. A gentle bedtime story about first-day fear, and how comforting someone else is secretly how we get brave ourselves. For little dreamers starting something new, and the grown-ups walking them there.

stories.title: The Little Cloud Who Could Not Rain
stories.tease: In a valley that forgot the sound of rain, one small cloud is too little to help — until the night her heart grows heavier than any storm. A gentle summer bedtime story about feeling too small, for little dreamers and the grown-ups watching with them.
